pdfWizardNotice: The original workflow uses the PDF's four lunar tests, data-fitness aggregation and 15 study locations. Scores retain the 0-1 scale: PDF 40.8 equals 0.408. Reported results and proxy data remain labelled.
pdfWizardTargetNotice: M2/M3/M6 use shared Earth-achievable scoring anchors. M4 requires a separate terrain reference for the selected lunar target.
pdf_anchor_sensitivity_available: PDF anchor and task-weight rank sensitivity is available below.
pdf_target_terrain_missing: This target has no imported 30 m / 16 km terrain reference for the PDF's M4 model. Its other tests use shared Earth-achievable anchors; no Connecting Ridge terrain is substituted.
pdfSensitivityIntro: Ranking sensitivity to anchor endpoints +/-20% and alternative task weights. These are deterministic scenarios, separate from network-coverage simulations.
lunarStudyIntro: Explore the team's four-test method with 12 validation sites and three polar examples. Trace every score to a value, a formula and its data fitness.
lunarObjective: Scores express how closely an Earth environment approaches the specified Earth-achievable test anchors. They do not establish physical equivalence to the Moon.
lunarFormulaMeaning: s = feature similarity; c = data fitness (1.0 direct, 0.6 proxy, 0.3 reported judgement, 0 missing); w = normalized importance x uncertainty. Combine within each test, then apply the four test weights.
lunarFunction_histogram: Sum of minimum normalized bin fractions
lunarFunctionsExplained: Histograms are normalized before overlap. Missing values are omitted with c=0, never measured zeros. Negative temperature anchors use the same directed linear formula.
lunarRetiredTitle: Why M1 and M5 were removed
lunarSourcePdf: Read the supplied method PDF (Traditional Chinese)
lunarReferenceScope: This PDF model currently uses Connecting Ridge's slope histogram and 2477 m relief. The other lunar regions' earlier observations remain available separately.
lunarDifferentReference: This shared link selects another lunar reference
lunarDifferentReferenceNote: The link refers to {site}. The PDF model has no independently defined terrain reference for that target yet. Explicitly choose Connecting Ridge or open the earlier observed comparison.
lunarUseReference: Use the PDF's Connecting Ridge reference
lunarRetiredSummary: M1 and M5 are excluded from this study's scoring. Their definitions and results remain archived.
lunarThermalBlock: Share half of M6 weight between its correlated temperatures
lunarFeatureWeightsNote: Defaults are 1 x 1 because the team did not supply numerical I/U values. Each test normalizes its feature weights. These controls are assumptions, not uncertainty estimates.
lunarRankScope: Ranked among the imported study locations only. Data completeness differs across rows; a high partial score does not establish a complete analog.
lunarNoMatches: No imported locations match this filter.
lunarPartialWarning: These are provisional scores of the available evidence. Completeness is the weighted fraction of present features; data fitness also discounts proxies and reported judgements. Neither is a statistical confidence interval or a field-validation certificate.
lunarIceCoverUnknown: Permanent ice cover has not been verified for these windows. An annual-mean temperature threshold cannot classify an ice sheet.
lunarReportedM6: The PDF reports M6 = {score} for this regional example. Recalculation can differ because the document rounds temperatures and the controls change assumptions.
lunarSensitivityNote: Change one endpoint/reference by +/-20% at a time and compare PDF ROC, rank-sum and equal weights. Track rank correlation and top-three frequency; this is not statistical uncertainty propagation.
lunarGlobalNote: The PDF describes {count} land-grid points. Those global POWER and relief files were not in the supplied branch archive, so the website currently contains zero global overall-score cells.
lunarGlobalMapNote: The map and globe show the 15 imported study points, not a completed global heatmap. A global layer will require its own values, quality masks, ice screening and provenance.
lunarObservedArchive: Earlier lunar comparison model: archived reference
lunarDataInventoryNote: The lunar mission pages use the latest global handoff: four tasks, ten lunar terrain references and 19599 land cells. The observed snapshot below belongs to the earlier observed model and the current Mars workflow.
lunarValidationSummaryNote: Recomputed from current settings and imported values. AUC is the probability that a sampled first-group score exceeds a second-group score, with half credit for ties. These small hand-selected groups are not independent validation, and feature completeness can differ.
lunarPdfValidation: PDF-reported M6 means: polar 49.5, reference 10.1, control 3.6; reference/control AUC 0.73 and polar/control AUC 1.00. Rounded polar values, unknown checklist entries and changed controls can produce different recalculated results.
tagline:
Our home planet.
A testbed for other worlds.
intro: Start on Earth. Prepare for what comes next. Connect mission requirements to terrestrial sites, and make the strengths and limits of every analog visible.
compareIntro: Earth can reproduce some terrain and processes. Gravity, atmosphere and radiation set clear limits.
placeholder: Placeholder data is shown. These are not real scientific findings.
planetMapNote: Planetary coordinate diagram; no Earth basemap is used.
targetDemo: Target measurements use placeholders. Fallbacks are explicitly flagged.
sensitivityIntro: Seeded Dirichlet sampling shows how often a site is selected under changing weights.
dataIntro: Every score should be traceable. Competition Resources and supplementary portals are listed below. Product versions and coverage need team review.
notUsed: Not used yet; retained as a data portal
methodIntro: A replaceable starting point. Every assumption in view.
footer: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 · Team prototype; not an official NASA tool
mapOffline: Online basemap unavailable; candidate points and coordinates remain visible.
invalidWeights: Custom weights must sum to more than zero.
rankNote: Gap ranks and manual orders follow the team brief and need source review.
seedNote: Seed 42 · 20 demo sites · No scientific discoveries claimed
scienceNote: Understand what an analog can test before deciding where to go.
sensitivityStale: Settings changed. Run sensitivity analysis again.
researchIntro: From the four planning PDFs to explicit evidence, limits and next steps.
observedIntro: Measured windows from public datasets, separate from the mission demo.
observedMissing: No observed pilot has been imported yet. See the ingestion guide.
terrainDistribution: Slope distributions at a common analysis scale
weatherIntro: January 2025, local solar time. These coarse-grid reanalysis values do not measure lunar conditions.
observedOnly: Observed products and data-derived models only
observedTargets: Choose a study location with imported evidence. Unmeasured locations remain unavailable; values from another target are never substituted.
partialEvidenceNotice: This score describes the available comparable features only. Missing features prevent a complete task or mission score and cannot be counted as covered.
coverageRequiresComplete: Complete test coverage requires every required data pair and an aggregate test score above the threshold. A single matching feature does not complete the test.
taskComparisons: Comparisons by test and evidence coverage
noObservedEvidence: No validated numeric measurement has been imported.
rawSamplesOnly: Actual samples and documented bin means are plotted. Irregular satellite overpasses use points, without inventing values between observations.
pairingIntro: All lunar and Martian tests are mapped to planetary and Earth products. Imported context is kept distinct from comparable evidence. Open a comparison to inspect actual numbers and provenance.
fullProvenance: Full product provenance and quality metadata
missing_observed_measurement: Observed measurement missing on one or both sides.
sampling_or_quantity_not_comparable: The measured quantity or its sampling support is not comparable.
earth_proxy_requires_review: Earth proxy calibration still needs review.
small_manual_candidate_population_not_gl: Normalization uses three manual Earth windows; this is not a global search.
incomplete_evidence_not_a_full_mission_r: Incomplete evidence: no full mission ranking or complete-task coverage is inferred.
target_data_unavailable_no_fallback: This target has no imported measurements; no other target or demo is used as a fallback.
coverageDistinction: Comparable Earth data contributes to the feature results below. Data gaps, feature matches and complete tests are reported separately.
coverageReason_covered: A candidate has all required comparable features and its complete test score reaches the threshold.
coverageReason_partial: One or more observed features meet the threshold; complete test coverage is not established.
coverageReason_insufficient_data: Some features can be compared, while missing or incompatible pairs prevent a complete assessment.
coverageReason_no_comparable_data: No score-eligible pair is available for this test yet; existing context can still be inspected.
coverageReason_below_threshold: All current candidates can be fully evaluated, but none reaches the selected similarity threshold.
noCompleteTaskNetwork: No complete-test network can be selected at this threshold. The available feature matches and their Earth sites are shown below.
availableFeatureNetwork: Earth sites for the available features
availableFeatureNetworkIntro: Choose the smallest site set covering the observed features that meet the threshold. This feature-level result does not certify an entire test.
noFeatureMeetsThreshold: Comparable data exists, but none of these features currently reaches the threshold.
noComparableFeaturePairs: There are no score-eligible feature pairs for this selection yet. See the data gaps above.
featureMarginal: Benefit of additional sites for observed features
featureMarginalIntro: Weighted coverage of individual qualifying features, with missing requirements retained in the denominator. This is not complete-task coverage.
coordinateDiagramOnly: Coordinate overview, not surface imagery. Numbered labels below identify each verified location.
unplacedTargetCount: Proposed targets awaiting verified coordinates: {count}. These are not plotted.
noComparableScore: No comparable score for this selection
targetNotImportedDescription: This proposed location has no imported planetary measurements yet. Earth data alone cannot produce its similarity scores. Choose a location with imported evidence to compare; no other location is substituted automatically.
noComparableResults: The selected tests for {target} have no score-eligible two-sided pairs. Imported context can still be inspected below. Select tests with comparable data or choose a different target.
noComparableForTest: No score-eligible pair is available for this test at this target.
lunarMissionIntro: Choose a mission. First explore suitable lunar locations, then compare three new Earth analogs with three least-similar locations.
lunarDetailIntro: One mission, two perspectives: lunar task suitability and Earth analog similarity.
lunarPurposeM2: Test solar power, navigation and vision when sunlight stays close to the horizon.
lunarPurposeM3: Test power storage, insulation and equipment survival through extended darkness and extreme cold.
lunarPurposeM4: Test rover and astronaut mobility over steep slopes, ridges and crater terrain.
lunarPurposeM6: Test prospecting, drilling and handling of ice in cold and potentially frozen ground.
lunarOpenTask: Explore lunar sites and Earth comparisons
lunarRetiredNote: M1 and M5 are excluded by the supplied method. The four retained missions use the team's revised feature weights; task weights matter only for an optional combined score.
lunarWhereOnMoon: Where could this mission be assessed on the Moon?
lunarSuitabilityMeaning: These are preliminary, literature-based team assessments. They guide where to investigate a mission; they do not certify landing safety or operational feasibility.
lunarOtherSites: Other lunar locations — {count} with insufficient evidence
lunarUnassessedMeaning: An unlisted mission is not proven infeasible. The supplied assessment does not yet establish its suitability at these locations.
lunarSelectedUnassessed: This lunar site has terrain data, but its suitability for the selected mission is not established. The Earth comparison remains available as a research comparison.
lunarEarthContrast: Earth analogs: two groups for comparison
lunarNewCandidateMeaning: New candidates exclude established analog regions and permanent ice-sheet cells.
lunarLeastMeaning: Lowest available task scores within this task's eligible comparison pool.
lunarTieNote: Equal scores are ties; their order follows the source handoff and does not imply a meaningful difference. Place names are approximate grid labels.
lunarValidationMeaning: Established analogs can score higher than the new candidates. They are retained for validation and are not presented as newly discovered sites.
lunarScoreMeaning: A score measures similarity within the Earth-achievable test model, not the probability of mission success or physical equivalence to the Moon.
lunarMissingRule: Missing features are skipped in the weighted score and their availability stays visible. A partial score does not establish complete test coverage.
lunarFitnessMeaning: Data fitness c is 1.0 for direct-derived data, 0.6 for proxies and 0.3 for estimates. It changes the contribution to the score; it is not a statistical confidence level.
lunarSharedAnchor: The scoring anchors are shared Earth extremes, not measured values at this lunar site.
lunarArchiveNote: The new handoff supersedes the earlier 15-site validation model for this lunar experience. Earlier observed and research APIs remain archived separately.
lunarAiDisclosure: The source team discloses Claude assistance for its computations and data assembly. Codex assisted with this website integration and validation.
lunarUnknownSite: The shared link names an unknown lunar site. Return to the four missions and choose a listed site.
lunarResponseMismatch: The response does not match the selected task, site or data version. Please retry.
